newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN shares fall after company warning.
newsitem.headline: GAN shares fall after company warning.

text.p: French state-controlled insurer GAN was down nearly four percent in early trade on Friday after warning investors recent gains in its share price were not justified by the group's fundamentals.
At 0922 GMT, the shares had lost 3.79 percent to 126.90 francs in 32,155 shares traded.

In its statement, GAN said initial results from an audit into its exposure to bad property risks confirmed they would have a negative impact on its 1996 accounts. It confirmed it was in talks with the government to find solutions to the insurer's financial troubles.
A company source said earlier this month that GAN and the government were discussing an aid package but no decision had been taken.
GAN's shares, meanwhile, have been rising sharply in Paris on speculation it may be a bid target in the current round of consolidation in the insurance sector.
